name: Rexlet · Gremlet #38
description:
A tiny tyrannosaur with a huge roar and arms too short to hug. It tries anyway.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Rexlet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
